title: Integer separability of the Q22 routing surface
body: The five Q22 classes have distinct command prefixes. A signed multiclass perceptron over hashed first-token, token, positioned-token, and byte n-gram counts can separate those prefixes without floating-point operations. Seed changes affect training order only; the feature map, class order, initialization, update rule, and epoch count remain fixed.
claims: The model has 8192 deterministic hashed features and five signed integer output rows.
The outcome is evaluated only by the independent exact shared-task verifier.
